contractBoundary: Current signed path: POST /receipt/v1, then local verification with raven-receipt-verifier and an independently authenticated signer pin. POST /verify is legacy v2 compatibility. Local MCP is unsigned developer output, not a signed receipt-v1 fallback.
summary: Raven is a read-only preflight tool. It never needs your wallet, signer, or private keys; it never submits transactions, routes trades, or chooses allocation. Run it BEFORE any wallet-capable, swap-capable, listing-capable, or routing-capable tool.
forbiddenInputs: private keys / seed phrases (never send; never logged)
forbiddenCapabilities: arbitrary filesystem access (receipt storage path only)
recommendedSandbox: Network egress restricted to the verifier endpoint or local MCP; no wallet handles in the Raven tool's scope; receipt storage as the only write path.
receiptStorageRequirement: Store the exact current receipt-v1 object plus the separate local verifier result (append-only). /receipt-schema.json is legacy v2 storage compatibility.
signatureVerificationRequirement: For receipt-v1, recompute payloadHash, check receiptId, verify signature with signerPublicKey, and match signerPublicKey to an independently authenticated pin. /pubkey is a cross-check only. Legacy v2 separately uses keyId.
ordering: Raven runs first; decision policy (/decision-policy.json) applies after verification; re-verify before material delayed actions.
disclaimer: Not financial advice; no price prediction.
minimumPermissions: call hosted POST /receipt/v1 when a signed deliverable is required; call the explicitly unsigned local MCP only for developer output
read local receipt fixtures for tests
forbiddenPermissions: using an LLM to override the deterministic verdict
